steps.en: Check whether the notice already has a temporary suspension
steps.id: Cek apakah notice sudah punya temporary suspension
steps.why_en: The check only exists in the trial run, not in the real apply.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan hanya ada di mode percobaan, tidak di penerapan sebenarnya.

steps.en: No old suspension, so the request goes on to be applied
steps.id: Tidak ada suspension lama, jadi request lanjut diterapkan

steps.en: Tell PLUS the notice already has a temporary suspension
steps.id: Beri tahu PLUS bahwa notice sudah punya temporary suspension
steps.why_en: The system says the notice is eligible and applies it again without warning.
steps.why_id: Sistem menjawab notice layak dan langsung menerapkannya lagi tanpa peringatan.

steps.en: PLUS can look up the suspensions on a notice itself
steps.id: PLUS bisa melihat sendiri suspension yang ada pada notice
steps.why_en: PLUS has to ask for it; OCMS does not tell PLUS during the request.
steps.why_id: PLUS harus memintanya sendiri; OCMS tidak memberi tahu saat request diproses.
